srList.sentence: METHODS Participants The sample of this study, which was held between the dates 04.07.2020-11.07.2020, consists of a total 528 participants between the ages of 18-69 (30,81+-10,45) as 314 women (59,5) and 214 men (40,5) that were reached online by snowball method in accordance with convenience method.

srList.sentence: 528 participants were randomly divided in two groups in SPSS and Explanatory Factor Analysis (EFA) and Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) were applied separately to the datasets of 264 participants.
